span.p: 第10章实践对比

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: L10-1 协议工具快速连接

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 抽象：MCPTool、A2ATool、ANPTool

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 控制：统一 Tool 接口

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
优势：低成本建立全局认识
注意：不覆盖完整协议生命周期

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: L10-2 MCP 连接与多 Agent 协作

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 抽象：Server、Client、Transport 与 Tool

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 控制：客户端—服务器

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
优势：生态成熟、工具边界清晰
注意：服务进程和权限管理复杂

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: L10-3 A2A 智能体通信

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 抽象：Agent Card、Task 与 Artifact

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 控制：点对点任务生命周期

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
优势：适合专业 Agent 团队
注意：发现和信任需额外基础设施

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: L10-4 ANP 服务发现与任务分发

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 抽象：Registry、Router 与 Load Balancer

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 控制：注册发现与动态路由

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
优势：面向开放网络扩展
注意：生态和标准成熟度较低

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: L10-5 自定义天气 MCP Server

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 抽象：FastMCP 服务与天气工具

span.p: 控制：服务端工具发布

span.p:
优势：形成端到端开发闭环
注意：需要处理外部 API 和服务运行
